confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded estimates from aggregated search snippets. Sources are mixed in date and method, several are crowdsourced or theme-park or hotel menus, and no official Tokyo price index was retrieved. Beer and cappuccino rest on the most usable data. Cocktail is a rough midpoint of conflicting sources. Wine is derived from the beer price, since no reliable wine-by-the-glass price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for Tokyo in July, not checked against live listings. Yen-to-USD conversion assumes roughly 158 JPY per USD, based on an early-2026 travel guide. The FX observation was taken from RBA Exchange Rates page content surfaced in search results; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Tokyo-specific yen price points from search results. Wine is set relative to the local beer price. Accommodation anchors come from general knowledge of Tokyo's budget, guesthouse and business-hotel market in peak summer season.
